From Summer to Cozy | Easy Ways to Transition Your Home to Fall

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:55
Instaread

As fall quickly approaches, it’s a great time to start bringing a little warmth and coziness back into the home. You don’t need a complete seasonal makeover to make your space feel warm and inviting. A few simple swaps, like adding soft textures, warm colors, seasonal scents and natural touches, can instantly bring that cozy fall feeling indoors. Whether you’re refreshing one room or adding little autumn details throughout your home, here are some easy ways to welcome the season in style.

Start With Warm, Cozy Textures

One of the easiest ways to transition your home from summer to fall is by layering in softer, cozier textures. Swap lightweight summer throws for chunky knit or woven blankets, add a few plush pillows to the sofa and bring warmer fabrics into bedrooms and living spaces. You don’t have to completely change your color palette, either. Shades of cream, camel, rust, olive green and warm brown can add just enough seasonal color while still feeling timeless.

Bring the Fall Vibes Outdoors

Don’t forget about your outdoor spaces when giving your home a fall refresh. Late summer and early fall are some of the best times to enjoy the porch, patio or backyard as the temperatures become a little cooler. Start transitioning the space with seasonal touches like potted mums, pumpkins, lanterns and a simple fall wreath on the front door. Add outdoor pillows and throw blankets in warm, earthy tones to make seating areas feel extra inviting.

Give Everyday Spaces a Seasonal Refresh

You don’t need to redecorate the entire house to embrace the season. Focus on the little spaces you use every day. Add a fall hand towel and a small arrangement to the kitchen, style the coffee bar with your favorite seasonal mugs or place a cozy throw over the chair where you drink your morning coffee. Small changes throughout the home often make the biggest difference.
